name: Opportunistic Provocateur
description: This flesh possesses the powers of both Destruction and Abundance, a form that embodies the cycle of death and rebirth. It is also the first "fruit" borne from the rejuvenated Ambrosial Arbor.

skills.name: Acchata: Forming Winds
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Cleansing Sweep
skills.description: Deals minor Wind DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Entwining Roots: Abundance's Might
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to a single target and delays their action. At the same time, allows all Abundance Lotus on the field that can take action to launch an attack.

skills.name: Entwining Roots: Havoc's Might
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target and delays their action. At the same time, allows all Destruction Lotus on the field that can take action to launch an attack.

skills.name: Acchata: Roaring Thunder
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Starfall, Mooncry: Abundance's Might
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to all targets and shifts to Abundance Form.

skills.name: Starfall, Mooncry: Destruction's Might
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and shifts to Destruction Form.

skills.name: Twin Bond
skills.description: Summons Abundance Lotus and Destruction Lotus.

skills.name: Furor
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target and any adjacent targets.

skills.name: Arbor Apotheosis
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Twin Bond
skills.description: Summons Abundance Lotus and Destruction Lotus.

skills.name: Entwining Roots: Paramount Writhe
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and delays their actions, while also causing all Lotuses on the field that can take action to launch an attack.

skills.name: Null
skills.description: Locks onto all targets. All lotuses' will use Eternal Condemnation in the next action.

skills.name: Eternal Condemnation
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to the locked-on target. The more locked-on targets there are, the higher the DMG.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Flower By Another Name
tags.description: When a new Lotus is summoned, Boss Mirage will enter the <color=#f29e38ff><u> Toughness Protection</u></color> state. Defeating any summon will dispel the Boss Mirage's Toughness Protection and deal additional Toughness Reduction to the Boss Mirage.

tags.name: Withered Tree's Revival
tags.description: In Phase I, when Boss Mirage changes form, the summons will restore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> HP.

tags.name: Hollowflower Blaze
tags.description: In Phase II, the summons' Max HP increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

phases.name: Phase I: Versicolored Radiance
phases.description: Boss Mirage will switch between the Abundance Form and the Destruction Form, and will summon a Lotus while switching.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat as many Abundance Lotus or Destruction Lotus (choose one or the other) to gain more buffs.

skills.name: Counters target's Max HP reduction effect

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel Prana-Siphon. Defeat summons to reduce the debuffs.

skills.name: Counters the Toughness Protection state of the Boss Mirage

texts.description: Defeating any summon will dispel the Boss Mirage's Toughness Protection and deal additional Toughness Reduction to the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Select the appropriate Lotus according to the characters' needs to defeat

texts.description: Defeating Lotus can gain buffs for allies: Defeat Abundance Lotus to receive All-Type DMG Boost and defeat Destruction Lotus to receive Break Effect Boost. Only one of the above buffs can be obtained. You can select the corresponding Lotus to defeat based on the buff needed by the characters.

phases.name: Phase II: Greed Breeds Danger
phases.description: Entities summoned by Boss Mirage will lock onto a target and use Eternal Condemnation against them, dealing massive DMG.
phases.answer: Strategy: Try to defeat the summoned entities before they use Eternal Condemnation to gain buffs and Weaken the power of Eternal Condemnation.

skills.name: Counters the massive DMG from the "Eternal Condemnation" ability unleashed by the summons

texts.description: Defeat as many Lotus as possible before Eternal Condemnation is released to reduce its damage.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
When a new Lotus is summoned, the Boss Mirage will enter the <color=#f29e38ff>Toughness Protection</color> state.

Every time Abundance Lotus is defeated, all allies' <color=#f29e38ff>All-Type DMG</color> can be increased. Every time Destruction Lotus is defeated, all allies' <color=#f29e38ff>Break Effect</color> can be increased. After obtaining one of the two buffs above, the other will become unable to be obtained.

texts.description: After <color=#f29e38ff>Breaking</color> Boss Mirage, the DMG it receives is greatly increased, Skill Points are recovered for the team, and the team's action is Advanced Forward.
Defeating <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> will dispel Boss Mirage's Toughness Protection and Weaken Boss Mirage.

Choose the appropriate Lotus to defeat based on the needs of characters: Defeat Abundance Lotus to increase allies' <color=#f29e38ff>All-Type DMG</color>, or defeat Destruction Lotus to increase allies' <color=#f29e38ff>Break Effect</color>.
